name: Apache Kafka® Streams
description: Examples of logging, copying and filtering (copying and altering) Apache Avro® messages, using Apache Kafka® streams and a schema registry.Kafka Streams is the standard library to use when taking data from one Kafka topic and writing an amended version to another, in real time. It is written in Java and kept up to date with Kafka itself.

name: Inventory manager
description: A product inventory demo, showcasing multiple services communicating, with a Node.js web backend, a React frontend, a PostgreSQL database, a Valkey cache, a Valkey queue, and a Go-based background job service.
